text:
Nina Park: RCA for the 2026-03-20 serving incident is live: https://redwood.internal/rca/2241234567. TL;DR and action items below. Please read and ack if you're assigned.

DevOps Bot: RCA published by @Nina Park  https://redwood.internal/rca/2241234567

Jordan Kim: Thanks Nina. Is the primary issue still the model tag mismatch + stale routing cache?

Nina Park: Yes. Root cause: model image tagging changed in the onboarding pipeline (we now add a prefix), but the routing rules expect legacy tags. The cache prevented immediate reconciliation so many requests hit a non-compatible variant.

Nina Park: Action items (owners + ETA):
- ITEM-1: Add tag canonicalization during image build and a post-deploy verification step (owner: @Jordan Kim, ETA: 2026-03-28)
- ITEM-2: Invalidate routing cache on model metadata change events (owner: @Liam O'Connor, ETA: 2026-03-25)
- ITEM-3: Add alert for model-tag/route drift (owner: @Nina Park, ETA: 2026-03-24)
- ITEM-4: Short-term: relax strict tag matching for 48h around deploys (owner: @DevOps Team, ETA: 2026-03-21)

Jordan Kim: I'll take ITEM-1. Plan: CI hook that runs a small mapping table and fails the build if mapping can't be resolved. Example check:
```bash
# in CI step
if ! grep -q "^canonical:" tags.yaml; then
  echo "Missing canonical tag mapping"; exit 1
fi
```
I'll open PR today.

Liam O'Connor: I'll handle ITEM-2. Thinking: listen to model_registry webhook -> emit routing-cache-invalidate job. Will craft the webhook handler + small replay test.

Nina Park: ITEM-3 note: I'll add the rule to the alerting playbook and wire to PagerDuty low-priority.

Jordan Kim: question: who re-enabled the emergency fallback and when? Need it in timeline for the RCA.

DevOps Bot: Fallback toggle: enabled by @Liam O'Connor at 2026-03-20T09:18:42Z (audit-id: adf3f7b2).

Liam O'Connor: Yep that was me. It handled ~580 requests while the routing reconciled.

Nina Park: Please ack your items here. We'll run a 20-minute async check-in next Wed 09:30 PT. If any blocker surfaces, open a blocker label on the PR and ping #postmortems-checkins.

Jordan Kim: :white_check_mark: I ack ITEM-1, PR upcoming.

Liam O'Connor: :thumbsup: ack ITEM-2, working on webhook handler.

Nina Park: :ok_hand: ack ITEM-3.

DevOps Bot: Reminder: add links to PRs in the RCA doc once available.

Nina Park: Thanks everyone. I'll post updated timeline + link list in the RCA by EOD.
